units.source_text: 不过，幸运的是他逐渐摆脱了那种迷信。

en.t: Fortunately, however, he gradually freed himself from that superstition.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，他还在西洋历史中发现了反证那种迷信的事实。

en.t: Not only that, he also found facts in Western history that disproved that superstition.

units.source_text: 据说罗马建国者罗慕路斯竟然是吃一只母狼的奶水长大的。

en.t: It is said that Romulus, the founder of Rome, was actually raised on the milk of a she-wolf.

units.source_text: 从那以后，他就对没吃过母乳这件事不再耿耿于怀了。

en.t: After that, he no longer brooded over the fact that he had never been fed breast milk.

units.source_text: 不，准确的说是他甚至对喝牛奶长大这件事感到隐隐的骄傲。

en.t: No, to be precise, he even felt a faint pride in having been raised on cow's milk.

units.source_text: 信辅记得，他刚上初中的那年春天，他和有些年长的叔父一道儿去叔父经营的牧场。

en.t: Shinsuke remembered that in the spring of the year he had just entered middle school, he went with his somewhat older uncle to the ranch that his uncle ran.

units.source_text: 当时他费尽力气才把穿着制服的胸口贴在栅栏上，

en.t: At the time, he strained with all his might just to press the chest of his uniform against the fence,

units.source_text: 把手里的干草喂给走到自己面前的白牛吃。

en.t: and fed the hay in his hand to a white cow that had come up in front of him.

units.source_text: 白牛抬起脸看着他，一声不吭的把鼻子放在干草上闻。

en.t: The white cow lifted its face and looked at him, then silently lowered its nose to the hay and sniffed it.

units.source_text: 当他也抬头看牛脸的时候，他发现牛的眼睛里似乎有什么和人类相似的感情。

en.t: When he too raised his head and looked at the cow's face, he found that there seemed to be some feeling in its eyes resembling that of a human being.

units.source_text: 是幻想吗？——可能是自己的幻想吧。

en.t: Was it an illusion? It was probably an illusion of his own.

units.source_text: 在他的记忆里，他倚在杏花盛开的树枝下的栅栏上，有一头大白牛仰着头凝视她。

en.t: In his memory, he was leaning against the fence beneath branches blooming with apricot blossoms, and a large white cow was gazing up at her.

units.source_text: 那头牛好像满怀深情，十分怀念一样……

en.t: The cow seemed full of deep feeling, as if overcome with longing...
